subject: Discovery recap — Observability & Evals for BrightBank
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:10:00-05:00
Subject: Discovery recap — Observability & Evals for BrightBank

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, success criteria, and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you described
- Lack of deterministic alerting for model regressions after rollouts (false positives/negatives).
- No single-pane view tying production latency/cost to prompt/eval quality.
- Manual triage when model behavior drifts (no golden prompt set or automated regression checks).
- Audit/log retention and traceability requirements for regulatory reviews.

Current stack you shared
- Core LLM service: in-house model gateway + third-party open models for non-PII workloads.
- Metrics: Datadog for infra metrics, Splunk for logs, separate eval spreadsheets.
- Deployment: Canary via internal CI; no automated rollback based on quality.

Success criteria (what BrightBank defined)
- Regression detection: catch >90% of meaningful quality regressions within first 48h of rollout.
- Observability: per-route dashboards showing latency, token cost, failure rate, and eval score.
- Auditability: immutable request-level traces and 7-year retention for requests flagged as regulated.
- POC target: 1 production route (customer support triage) instrumented end-to-end for 6 weeks.

Requested deliverables from Redwood
- Sample dashboard mockups for the support-triage route (latency, cost, eval score, golden-prompt pass rate).
- Tracing hooks and a short integration guide for your gateway (request/response correlation IDs).
- A recommended golden prompt set + an initial regression-alert rulebook.
- A draft mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed timeline for a 6-week POC.

Proposed next steps
1) Redwood will send: sample dashboards, tracing integration doc, and a MAP by EOD Monday (attached: BrightBank-obs-recap.pdf).
2) BrightBank to introduce procurement contact and confirm compliance constraints (audit retention specifics).
3) Joint call next week to agree scope and calendar for POC kickoff — proposed slots below.

Proposed times for follow-up (next week): Tue 3/3 10–11am ET, Wed 3/4 2–3pm ET. Let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scoped.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: BrightBank-obs-recap.pdf (one-page summary)
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@brightbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, procurement@brightbank.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Observability & Evals for BrightBank

Thanks Jonas — this is great and captures the discussion well. A couple clarifications from our side: 
- Audit retention: regulated requests (PII flagged) need immutable logs retained for 7 years; non-regulated logs can be 1 year.
- On the golden prompts: we’ll provide an initial seed set, but we’ll need Redwood to help expand and tag them by intent and severity.

I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@brightbank.com) to start the paperwork conversation — they’ll want a rough estimate of POC cost and any required security/attestation artifacts (SOC 2 report, data-flow diagram).

Also: the support team asked whether your dashboards can surface per-model token cost in USD (not just tokens)—that’s a must for our finance owners.

We can take Tue 3/3 10–11am ET for the follow-up. Please send the invite.

Thanks — adding a few operational items and sharing the MAP draft + links.

Operational notes (Redwood commit for POC)
- Dashboards: we’ll prepare per-route dashboards (latency pctls, 99/95/50, avg cost in USD, eval score over time, golden-prompt pass rate).
- Tracing: lightweight tracing hooks (header-based correlation ID) + a short Node/Python snippet for your gateway team.
- Evals: we’ll onboard your seed golden prompts and expand to ~120 prompts covering high/med/low severity with automated pass/fail thresholds.
- Regression alerts: configurable alerts (Slack/email) plus an automated canary rollback trigger tied to eval-score drop >X% (to be agreed).

Attached is a draft MAP and a high-level POC timeline. Also linking the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-7890. MAP attachment: MAP-BrightBank.xlsx.

Next internal steps for Redwood: Marissa will lead dashboard mockups; I’ll own tracing docs and MAP finalization.

On follow-up call (Tue 3/3 10am ET) we’ll:
- Walk the dashboard mockups
- Share tracing integration snippet
- Agree on the initial golden prompts and POC success metrics
